parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description: Specifies whether automatic payment is enabled when you upgrade the instance type. Valid values:

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the temporary specification change. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The target instance type for the Upgrade/Downgrade. For more information, see [Instance family](~~25378~~) or invoke [DescribeInstanceTypes](~~25620~~).

parameters.name: MigrateAcrossZone
parameters.description: Specifies whether cross-cluster instance type upgrades are supported. Valid values:

parameters.name: RebootTime
parameters.description: The restart time of the instance. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: RebootWhenFinished

parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
